The '''Research Probe''' was a type of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] created by the ''[[Gray Secant]]'', a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Starship/Legends|starship]], for the purpose of testing the combat capabilities of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] lifeforms at the ''Gray Secant''{{'s}} research pylons. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] came in two identical variations&mdash;Mk-II and the more powerful Mk-IV. When the pylons were activated, the ''Gray Secant'' would dispatch a trio of Research Probes, [[Research Combatant]]s, or [[Research Battler]]s to that pylon.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Research Probe appears as an enemy involved in the Heroic mission "Primary Testing" during the Relics of the Gree World Event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]],<ref name="TOR" /> which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.7: Return of the Gree on [[February 12]], [[2013]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.7.0/return-gree|text=Game Update 1.7: Return of the Gree Patch Notes}}</ref> Two variations appear: the Research Probe Mk-IV, groups of which can be summoned at the three pylons in the northern section of the [[Western Ice Shelf]], and the Research Probe Mk-II, groups of which can be summoned in the open world player-vs-player zone in the center of the area. The Mk-II, like the Mk-II versions of the three other Gree droids involved in the mission, is reduced in strength to make it possible for smaller groups to complete the mission in an area where they can be attacked by other players.<ref name="TOR" />
